_doc.vehicle.mass: whole car including the driver, kg
_doc.vehicle.weight_front: fraction of the weight on the front axle
_doc.targets_file: optional shared team targets JSON, path relative to this design file
_doc.spring: optional block (null = not modeled); see spring_defaults
_doc.loads.pothole_g: impact: vertical load as a multiple of the static wheel load
_doc.loads.kerb_g: impact: sideways load on the wheel (pushing it inboard), multiple of the static load
_doc.loads.brake_split: 'bias': braking force shared by vehicle.front_brake_share; 'grip': Fx = g x Fz
_doc.loads.lltd_front: front lateral load transfer share; null = from the car's roll balance or the weight split
_doc.members.rod_end_rating: N, the rod end's catalog radial static (ultimate) rating; null = not checked
_doc.members.bolt_dia: mm, bolt through each rod end (7.94 = 5/16 in)
_doc.members.rod_end_k: N/mm, axial stiffness of one rod end (each link has two); an estimate
_doc.members.mount_k: N/mm, chassis tab or bracket at the inboard end of each link; an estimate
_doc.members.toe_comp_limit: deg, largest acceptable compliance toe change (cornering, braking, accel)
_doc.members.camber_comp_limit: deg, largest acceptable compliance camber change
_doc.spring.rocker_axis: direction of the rocker pivot bolt
_doc.spring.damper_bump_low: N per m/s at the shaft, from the damper dyno; also _high and rebound_low/_high
_doc.spring.damper_knee: mm/s shaft speed where low-speed turns into high-speed
_doc.sweep.bump_travel: mm of bump to check (null = travel); with droop_travel, for a car whose travel isn't symmetric
_doc.sweep.droop_travel: mm of droop to check (null = travel)
_doc.sweep.pack_heave_steps: heave positions searched for the tightest link clearance (x pack_rack_steps rack positions at the front)
_doc.wheel.rim_inner_radius: mm, radius of the inside of the rim barrel; null = rim radius - 15 mm (an estimate: measure your wheel)
_doc.wheel.caliper: optional brake caliper envelope: {clock_deg (0 = forward, 90 = top), radius (mm, axle to caliper center), size (mm, bounding diameter), offset (mm along the axle, + outboard)}
_doc.vehicle.aero_front: N of downforce on the front axle at your design speed (optional): reports sag and the ride frequency there
_doc.vehicle.aero_rear: N of downforce on the rear axle at your design speed (optional)
_doc.halfshaft: rear, optional: {diff_output: [x,y,z] inboard CV center, cv_outboard: [x,y,z] outboard CV center at ride height, cv_angle_max_in / cv_angle_max_out (deg), plunge_max (mm)}
_doc.members.rack_k: N/mm, steering rack and its mounts along the rack (front compliance; optional estimate)
_doc.members.column_k: N m/deg at the steering wheel, column torsion (needs vehicle.rack_c_factor; optional estimate)
_doc.clearance.halfshaft_od: mm, halfshaft tube OD for its clearance to the links
_doc.clearance.caliper_margin: mm, gap the caliper needs to the rim barrel and the links
_doc.members.rod_end_misalign: deg, the rod ends' catalog misalignment limit (each side of square); joints.<key>.allow overrides one joint
_doc.members.bearing_misalign: deg, the spherical bearings' (ball joints') catalog misalignment limit
_doc.joints: per-joint overrides keyed like the hardpoints and spring points: {"bolt": "x"|"y"|"z"|"pivot"|"kingpin"|"rocker"|[x, y, z], "square": true|false, "type": "rod_end"|"bearing", "allow": deg, "align": mm of wheel travel where a ball joint is square (ball joints only)}
_doc.spring.spring_rate2: N/mm, second rate of a dual-rate spring, from spring_breakpoint on (optional)
_doc.spring.spring_breakpoint: mm of damper compression beyond ride height where spring_rate2 takes over
_doc.spring.bumpstop_gap: mm of damper compression beyond ride height before the bump stop touches (optional; 0 = touching at ride height)
_doc.spring.bumpstop_k: N/mm, bump stop rate at first touch (needed with bumpstop_gap)
_doc.spring.bumpstop_k2: N/mm^2, makes the bump stop progressive: force = k d + k2 d^2 for d mm of squash (optional)
_doc.vehicle.tire_mu: tire friction coefficient at its static load (for the limit balance; 1.5 if not given)
_doc.vehicle.tire_load_sens: tire load sensitivity k: mu = tire_mu (1 - k (Fz / Fz0 - 1)); fit it to your tire data (e.g. TTC); null = off
_doc.arb: optional anti-roll bar linkage for this axle: {link_on: lower|upper|upright|rocker, link_outboard: [x,y,z] drop link's lower end, arm_tip: [x,y,z] the bar arm's end, bar_pivot: [x,y,z] a point on the bar axis, bar_axis: [0,1,0], bar_od, bar_wall (null = solid), bar_length (active length between arms; null = 2 x |arm_tip y|), bar_G (MPa, 79300 steel), bar_yield (MPa)}; replaces the car's arb number for this axle
_doc.members.uts: MPa, ultimate tensile strength of the tubes (4130 normalized about 670); sets the fatigue endurance limit
_doc.members.surface: tube surface for the endurance limit: ground, machined, cold-drawn, hot-rolled or as-forged
_doc.members.fatigue_sf: required margin on the fatigue screen (allowed stress at the cycle count / applied stress); 1.5 typical
_doc.members.weld_fat_tube: MPa, fatigue class (IIW FAT: stress range at 2 million cycles) of the weld at each tube end; a conservative pick, look up your detail
_doc.members.weld_fat_tab: MPa, fatigue class of the fillet weld holding each tab, judged on its throat (IIW about 36 for load-carrying fillet welds)
_doc.members.tab: mm, the pickup tabs (a pair per link end, double shear): thickness, width, edge (hole center to the tab's end), weld_leg, weld_length (per tab), count; defaults are a typical 1/8 in tab, change them to yours
_doc.members.tab_yield: MPa, the tab material's yield (null = members.yield)
_doc.members.gusset: how the pushrod mount is reinforced (null = bare tube): {thickness, height, length_in, length_out} mm for a triangular plate along the leg (height at the mount; fat = its end weld's IIW class, default by length), or {type: to_node} for a bracket into the ball-joint node (check the bracket in FEA)
_doc.members.rocker: the rocker's plates, to check them (null = not checked): {thickness (each plate), plates (default 2), pivot_bore (bearing or bushing OD), pivot_edge (pivot center to the hub's edge), pin_dia (pushrod and damper bolts; default bolt_dia), edge (those holes' centers to the plate's edge), width (narrowest depth of each arm), yield (MPa, default 241: 6061-T6)} mm
_doc.loads.fatigue_cycles: how many times each driving case (cornering, braking, acceleration) repeats in the fatigue screen; about 10,000 hard events per season, default 100,000 (three seasons with margin)
_doc.loads.fatigue_bump_cycles: how many times the bump case repeats in the fatigue screen (default 10,000)

members.material: 4130 chromoly steel, normalized (yield is lower next to welds)
